title: Replace a Social Security card
description: Start a free replacement card request.
howTo: Check whether you can apply online. If not, follow the appointment instructions.
importantNotes: There is no fee for a replacement card.

title: Social Security card paper application (SS-5)
description: Print the form for an original or replacement Social Security card.
howTo: Print the PDF, complete and sign page 5 in black or blue ink, and bring it with the required original documents to your local Social Security office.
importantNotes: Applying for a Social Security card is free. Read pages 1–4 for document requirements.

title: New Hampshire ID card
description: See how to apply for a non-driver ID.
howTo: Review identity and residency requirements before visiting DMV.

title: Duplicate NH license or non-driver ID (DSMV637)
description: Request a replacement for a lost or damaged NH driver license or non-driver ID.
howTo: Use this only if replacing an existing card. Print and complete the form, then check DMV instructions for required ID and fees.
importantNotes: For a first-time ID, use the separate NH DMV resource above.

title: Birth certificate
description: Request a certified NH birth record.
howTo: Check who can request a copy and what ID or fees are required.
importantNotes: For births outside NH, contact that state or territory.

title: How to file a motion (checklist)
description: A New Hampshire court checklist for preparing a motion.
howTo: Read the checklist, then confirm the current filing steps with the court clerk.
importantNotes: Court forms and filing rules can change; ask the court which forms apply.

title: Motion form (NHJB-2201-DFP)
description: General court form for requesting an action in an existing case.
howTo: Enter the case information and your request. Confirm filing and service steps with the court.
importantNotes: Use only if this motion form fits your case; court staff can explain filing steps.

title: Motion to waive filing fee (NHJB-2759-SUP)
description: Ask the court to consider waiving a filing fee.
howTo: Complete the form and ask the court how to submit it with your filing.
importantNotes: The court decides whether a filing fee can be waived.

title: Motion to vacate default or recall warrant (NHJB-2978-D)
description: Court form to ask for review of a default and/or warrant.
howTo: Read the form and check with the court or your lawyer about filing it in your case.
importantNotes: Submitting a form does not itself change a court order or warrant.

title: Request for a lawyer (NHJB-4044-DSSUPe)
description: Request court-appointed counsel in a qualifying case.
howTo: Complete the requested information and ask the court how to submit the form.
importantNotes: Eligibility depends on the case and the court’s decision.

title: Court change of address (NHJB-2409-DFP)
description: Notify the court when your mailing address changes.
howTo: Enter your case and new address. Ask the clerk how to file the notice and notify other parties.
importantNotes: Keep your contact information current with the court.
